regime_context: TSX thematic structure shows Big Banks in a broad-based, durable trend with all constituents participating (breadth 1.0), though increasingly crowded (z 1.17). The absolute trend gate is active and historically helped reduce drawdown, while cross-sectional momentum is only an attention lens. Rotation margin is wide (0.68), with no confirmed handoff.
emerging_watch: Pipelines & Midstream – closest challenger but margin still wide. Watch if margin narrows meaningfully; kill-criterion: if margin stays above 0.5 for 10 trading days, remove from watch.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks exhibit the strongest durable trend with full breadth, trend persistence (Hurst), and an active absolute-trend gate that has historically cut drawdown on TSX themes. While crowded, the gate provides risk-control justification for overweight exposure, while the high durability bar (0.75) and eligibility suggest the trend is intact.
evidence: Rank #1, score 1.548 — strongest momentum leadership (focus lens)
Eligible and absolute trend gate helped historically (gate_helps true, validated risk control)
theses.dissent: Crowded positioning (z 1.17) raises reflexivity risk; a macro shock (hawkish Bank of Canada, domestic credit event) could trigger a sharp unwind despite trend strength.

falsifier.text: Big Banks becomes ineligible (absolute trend gate triggers false) OR durability bar drops below 0.5.
